sn30.2:1.6: Tatra bhikkhave aṇḍajā supaṇṇā aṇḍaje nage haranti || na jalābuje || na saṃsedaje || na opapātike || || 5
sn30.2:1.7: Tatra bhikkhave jalābujā supaṇṇā aṇḍaje ca jalābuje ca nāge haranti || na saṃsedaje na opapātike || || 6
sn30.2:1.8: Tatra bhikkhave saṃsedajā supaṇṇā aṇḍaje ca jalābuje ca saṃsedaje ca nāge haranti || na opapātike || || 7
sn30.2:1.9: Tatra bhikkhave opapātika supaṇṇā aṇḍaje ca jalābuje ca saṃsedaje ca opapātike ca nāge haranti || || 8
sn30.2:1.10: Imā kho bhikkhave catasso supaṇṇayoniyo ti || || 1 Sāvatthi ||
